investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (420) was observed for Linda.Kask@globalcorp.ee, a Senior Accountant in Finance, from the Finance Reporting site. The 420 files exceed the 24-hour baseline of 45 and include sensitive documents such as VAT reports, invoices, and payroll data. The activity occurred during local business hours in Tallinn and used a standard browser agent; no outbound data transfer to an external endpoint is evident in the provided evidence. Given the user role, site context, and timing, this appears more consistent with legitimate bulk reporting activity rather than an immediate data exfiltration threat, and is therefore categorized as LP.
